children: Five Below entered into a Third Amendment to its asset-based Credit Agreement to boost liquidity and extend borrowing capacity. The amendment increases the senior secured revolving credit facility from $225 million to $450 million and lifts the letter of credit subline from $20 million to $50 million. It also extends the facility’s maturity from September 16, 2027 to October 14, 2031. Wells Fargo Bank remains agent for the lending syndicate.
